caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

Your internet data isn't just 'in the cloud'... it's actually traveling as LIGHT, bouncing endlessly inside hair-thin GLASS threads!

Here's the mind-blowing reality:
🔹 Fiber optic cables guide laser light by bouncing it off their inner walls (called total internal reflection).
🔹 This happens thousands of times per meter, at nearly 200,000 kilometers per second!
🔹 It's how 99% of global data moves with near-zero loss, powering your entire digital life.
